scope: cli-top50-fixed-schema-sweep-r1: every operation Atlassian's own OpenAPI description declares under `paths` -- 617 operations across 421 path keys, counted one per (method, path). The shipped bundle's 15 rows were 12 comma-joined and wildcard families standing for hundreds of endpoints; a wildcard row is not an operation, so they are replaced rather than extended. Artifact sha256 5a51740d7ab3c77c521fc8895a7a58b4ff684bc0d2ebeb830135e8320b063ced (info.version 1001.0.0-SNAPSHOT-5a5e48e6afe6af917438fab9030fd20c4392b55e): Atlassian serves a rolling SNAPSHOT at a single unpinned URL, so this sha, not a byte count, is what identifies the document this surface was derived from.
